ShortDescription: Fixes hydroelectric dams producing 0 MW after the Cities: Skylines II 1.6.2f1 update.
LongDescription: Compatibility fix for Cities: Skylines II 1.6.2f1. Fixes hydroelectric dams incorrectly producing 0 MW, showing Low Water Level despite sufficient water, displaying 0 W during placement, and failing to orient correctly with river flow. The mod only applies the fix when the known 1.6.2f1 regression is detected.
